name: Pray
overview: Scripture teaches that prayer is a vital, continuous communication with God, grounded in faith and persistence. Jesus instructs believers to pray with reverence and confidence, as shown in the Lord's Prayer (Matthew 6:9) and the promise that asking, seeking, and knocking will be rewarded (Matthew 7:7). Prayer is both a means to receive God's answers and a spiritual discipline to avoid temptation (Matthew 26:41, Jeremiah 33:3). Believers are encouraged to pray without ceasing, maintaining faith that God hears and responds to their desires (Luke 18:1, Mark 11:24).
